koppen_1991_2020_cell.bin.gz.meaning: class code 1 to 30; 0 = no class. The class holding the most of the cell's classed 1 km pixels; a tie goes to the lower code

koppen_1991_2020_cell_share.bin.gz.meaning: the majority's share of the cell's classed pixels, round-half-up of 255 * k / n

grid.order: flat index = r * 2880 + c; row 0 northernmost, r = floor((90 - lat) / 0.125); column 0 at longitude -180
